content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The key to a successful digital commerce stack lies in its ability to bypass traditional payment gateways and platform fees. By utilizing crypto payments, you can avoid the 10% fee charged by Gumroad, and instead, pay a mere 0.5% fee with NOWPayments. This infrastructure works because it puts you in control, allowing you to own your data, and your customers' data, without relying on third-party platforms.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to have a few essential components in place. This includes a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, and a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets. You'll also need to set up a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a minimal 0.5% fee.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a crucial step in deploying your digital commerce stack. You'll need to configure your crypto payment gateway, set up automatic payment verification, and integrate it with your delivery system. This can be done using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which can automate the delivery of digital products to your customers. With NOWPayments, you can receive payments in various cryptocurrencies, and have them automatically converted to USD at transaction time.
With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can save up to $921 in fees per month on 100 sales of a $97 product.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves configuring your storefront, loading your digital products, and testing your payment and delivery system. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you have full control over your storefront, and can customize it to fit your brand and needs. You can also track your sales and analytics, and make adjustments as needed to optimize your sales funnel.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital commerce stack grows, you'll need to scale your infrastructure to meet increasing demand. This involves optimizing your hosting and storage solutions, scaling your backend logic, and expanding your payment and delivery pipeline. With a sovereign digital commerce stack, you have the flexibility to scale as needed, without being limited by platform restrictions or fees.
